app.title: WAEaA Collector
app.description: Forensic artefact collector for incident response.
usage.examples:
Examples:
  %[1]s -o E:\evidence -r triage --authorized --case-id IR-2026-001 --examiner "J. Doe"
  %[1]s -o E:\evidence -r eventlogs,registry --vss --authorized
  %[1]s --list-rules
flag.source: source volume or directory to collect from (default: system drive, or / on Linux)
flag.output: destination directory for the evidence archive (required)
flag.rules: comma-separated list of rule or compound-rule IDs to run (required, e.g. triage)
flag.rules_dir: additional directory with custom YAML rules
flag.list_rules: list all available rules and exit
flag.vss: also collect from every existing Volume Shadow Copy (Windows only)
flag.no_dedup: disable SHA-1 de-duplication of identical files
flag.include: only collect files matching this glob (repeatable)
flag.max_file_size: skip files bigger than this size in MB (0 = unlimited)
flag.live: also run live-response commands (processes, network, sessions)
flag.no_zip: keep the collected files in a folder instead of a ZIP archive
flag.case_id: case identifier recorded in the chain of custody
flag.examiner: name of the examiner performing the acquisition
flag.notes: free-text notes recorded in the chain of custody
flag.authorized: confirm you are authorised to acquire evidence from this system
flag.lang: user interface language (it, en, es, fr, de)
legal.notice: AUTHORISED USE ONLY. This tool acquires forensic artefacts that may contain personal data. Run it only on systems for which you hold explicit, lawful authorisation. Your confirmation and identity are recorded in the chain of custody.
err.missing_rules: at least one rule is required (-r / --rules); use --list-rules to see them
err.not_authorized: you must confirm your authorisation with --authorized
interactive.not_implemented: Interactive mode is not available yet in this build. Run with --help for command-line usage.
interactive.no_terminal: No interactive terminal detected. Run with --help for command-line usage.
